mentions.name: Sci-fi editor
mentions.description: This is a writing tool for sci-fi authors that helps them avoid timeline and physics inconsistencies in their stories and provides assistance with science and history details.
mentions.problem: Existing sci-fi writing tools are underwhelming, and writers have to worry about timeline and physics inconsistencies.
mentions.source_excerpt: 2. Sci-fi editor: Even though sci-fi tells the most futuristic stories, the tools are just meh? I am trying to make something so you don’t have to worry about timeline and physics inconsistencies. It will help you with science and histories.
